# ENCE & MICE - Synchronous vs Serial Plots

Reads the .rds outputs from cluster runs synchronous_vs_serial.Rmd
and synchronous_vs_serial_mice.Rmd, and reproduces the Section 4.1 prints and
plots

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
cutoff <- 0.50  # Completeness cutoff to plot

tag       <- sprintf("cutoff%02d", round(cutoff * 100))
ence_file <- sprintf("section_4_1_ENCE_sync_vs_serial_%s.rds", tag)
#mice_file <- sprintf("section_4_1_MICE_sync_vs_serial_%s.rds", tag)

ence <- readRDS(ence_file)
#mice <- readRDS(mice_file)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions, message=FALSE}
report_metrics <- function(true, pred, method_name, elapsed) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  cat(method_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Time:  ", round(elapsed, 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("RMSE:  ", rmse, "\n")
  cat("Bias %:", sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100, "\n")
  cat("R2:    ", 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2), "\n")
  cat("SRMSE: ", rmse / mean(true), "\n\n")
}

plot_obs_pred <- function(observed, predicted, method_name = "Method") {
  op <- par(pty = "s")
  on.exit(par(op))
  lims <- range(c(observed, predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(observed, predicted,
       xlim = lims, ylim = lims,
       xlab = "Observed", ylab = "Predicted",
       main = paste(method_name, ": Observed vs Predicted"),
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.12))
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  grid()
}
```

# ENCE

```{r ence_unpack}
meta <- ence$meta
cat("ENCE Section 4.1\n")
cat("cutoff:", meta$cutoff, " K:", meta$K, " seed:", meta$seed,
    " stations:", meta$n_stations, " observed:", meta$n_observed, "\n\n")

true_y      <- ence$true_y
serial_y    <- ence$serial_y
sync_y      <- ence$sync_y
serial_rmse <- ence$serial_rmse
sync_rmse   <- ence$sync_rmse
serial_val  <- ence$serial_val
sync_val    <- ence$sync_val
serial_time <- ence$serial_time
sync_time   <- ence$sync_time
```

```{r ence_metrics, results='hold'}
report_metrics(true_y, serial_y, "Serial", serial_time)
report_metrics(true_y, sync_y, "Synchronous", sync_time)

cat("Lambda agreement, pooled over", meta$K, "folds\n")
cat("  ", ence$lambda_match, "/", ence$lambda_valid, "\n")
cat("  ", round(100 * ence$lambda_match / ence$lambda_valid, 1), "%\n")
cat("Alpha agreement, pooled over", meta$K, "folds\n")
cat("  ", ence$alpha_match, "/", ence$alpha_valid, "\n")
cat("  ", round(100 * ence$alpha_match / ence$alpha_valid, 1), "%\n")
```

```{r ence_scatterplots, results='hold'}
plot_obs_pred(true_y, serial_y, "Serial")
plot_obs_pred(true_y, sync_y, "Synchronous")
```

```{r ence_convergence_plot, results='hold'}
col_serial <- "#234ec2"
col_sync   <- "#c20d0d"

xlim_range <- c(1, max(length(serial_rmse), length(sync_rmse)))
plot(serial_rmse, type = "b", col = col_serial, pch = 15,
     xlim = xlim_range,
     ylim = range(c(serial_rmse, sync_rmse)),
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Internal RMSE (between cycles)",
     main = "Convergence: Serial vs Synchronous")
grid()
lines(serial_rmse, type = "b", col = col_serial, pch = 15)
lines(sync_rmse,   type = "b", col = col_sync,   pch = 17)
legend("topright", legend = c("Serial", "Synchronous"),
       col = c(col_serial, col_sync), pch = c(15, 17), lty = 1)
```

```{r ence_RMSE_plot, results='hold'}
col_serial <- "#eb7500"
col_sync   <- "#7008d1"

xlim_range <- c(1, max(length(serial_val), length(sync_val)))
plot(serial_val, type = "b", col = col_serial, pch = 15,
     xlim = xlim_range,
     ylim = range(c(serial_val, sync_val)),
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Validation RMSE (masked cells)",
     main = "Validation RMSE: Serial vs Synchronous")
grid()
lines(serial_val, type = "b", col = col_serial, pch = 15)
lines(sync_val,  type = "b", col = col_sync,   pch = 17)
legend("topright", legend = c("Serial", "Synchronous"),
       col = c(col_serial, col_sync), pch = c(15, 17), lty = 1)
```
